verdict.rationale: Decagon's Insights & Reporting and Suggestions products let support leaders ask open-ended questions like 'Why are customers requesting refunds?', view heatmaps to catch spikes/dips, and auto-detect knowledge gaps from conversations — closely matching topic-level trend surfacing, and Watchtower flags custom criteria across every interaction. However, none of the docs explicitly describe automated topic clustering of conversations or proactive alerting tied to ticket-volume forecasting, and there's no independent/hands-on corroboration of this capability. Missing for 10: explicit topic-clustering mechanics, proactive spike-prediction alerting, and third-party validation.
